subject.title: feat: unify Claude Code / Codex session catalogs into native session UX

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose external coding-agent session catalogs through a public generic Plugin SDK and make operator catalogs visible whenever the owning plugin is active, independently of Codex supervision tools?
rationale: This PR creates a durable external API contract and changes the observable boundary of an existing configuration setting; tests cannot determine that product and compatibility commitment.

options.title: Reconcile and approve
options.body: Resolve current-main conflicts while preserving the generic catalog design, then require exact-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Land generic catalog display and protocol work separately from stateful adoption and enablement changes to reduce compatibility risk.

options.title: Retain current boundary
options.body: Keep plugin-specific catalog surfaces and supervision-gated Codex visibility instead of adding the permanent public contract.

recommendation.title: Reconcile and approve
recommendation.body: Resolve current-main conflicts while preserving the generic catalog design, then require exact-head live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the recent Claude/Codex session foundations and authored the canonical product issue, making them the strongest available owner for the API and UX direction.
